failure_summary.description: Both agents repeated a hotel base search instead of retrieving compatible cached hotel results and filtering newly supplied preferences.
One agent re-filtered an unchanged restaurant result and ran proximity analysis without an explicit proximity request.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly requires retrieve-filter-save for filter-only updates, limits actions to changed scopes, and prohibits unrequested proximity searches. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing guidance rather than an uncovered skill gap, so adding similar instructions would be duplicative.
